meta.name: lead-capture
meta.description: Converts anonymous traffic into known contacts — lead magnets, gated content, free tools, popups, and the forms behind them. Use this to design or improve a lead magnet, plan a free tool, add or fix popups and overlays, improve form conversion, or decide what is worth gating and what should stay open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把匿名访客变成可跟进的潜在客户
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做网站或落地页,想把访问者转化为可联系的销售线索。
copy.tagline_en: Turn anonymous visitors into trackable leads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and want to turn visitors into sales leads.

howto.what: Claude 会按本技能规则来判断和产出建议:只把模板/计算器这类可立即用的内容设门控,观点与公开内容保持开放;诱饵要做到让人乐意付费;弹窗按退出意图、滚动等行为触发且每访客只一次;表单字段越少越好。
howto.when: 当你想设计或改进 lead magnet(诱饵)、规划免费工具,或调整弹窗/表单等转化环节时触发;也用于判断内容该不该设门控。

say.text: 帮我改进这个落地页的弹窗:要让人愿意留邮箱但不招人烦。
say.note: 会按行为触发、每访客一次等原则给出改动。

say.text: 我想用免费测速工具收集客户,怎么设邮箱门槛最好?
say.note: 会建议先让用户免费使用,保存或导出结果时才要邮箱。

say.text: 这份行业报告,该公开引流还是做成资料包收线索?
say.note: 会按“是否希望被引用/竞品是否开放”等标准判断。

howto.what_en: Advice follows the skill: gate only useful assets, not thought-leadership or public content; lead magnets should be worth paying for; popups behavior-triggered once per visitor; minimal form fields.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user asks to design or improve a lead magnet, plan a free tool, or adjust popup/form conversion; also for deciding what to gate.

say_en.text: Help me improve this landing-page popup: get emails without annoying people.
I have a free speed-test tool; how should I gate it to collect leads?
say_en.note: Suggests letting users use it first and asking email only for save/export.

say_en.text: Should I keep this industry report public or gate it as a lead magnet?
